lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately three distinct horizontal rows with consistent spacing between nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal axes of high-luminance blobs, forming a clear checkerboard-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, showing high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the base and posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch or traumatic indentation is visible on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin. A thin, vertical linear mark of lower intensity is present on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher spatial frequency of small, densely packed high-luminance spots compared to the larger macropattern blobs observed on the primary lateral flank.
